   805  /**
   806   * This class implements Service Data TLV generation and parsing.
   807   *
   808   */
   809  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
   810  class ServiceTlv : public NetworkDataTlv
   811  {
   812  public:
   813      /**
   814       * This method initializes the TLV.
   815       * Initial length is set to 2, to hold S_service_data_length field.
   816       */
   817      void Init(void)
   818      {
   819          NetworkDataTlv::Init();
   820          SetType(kTypeService);
   821          SetLength(2);
   822          mTResSId = kTMask;
   823          SetServiceDataLength(0);
   824      }
   825
   826      /**
   827       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   828       *
   829       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   830       * @retval FALSE  If the TLV does not appear to be well-formed.
   831       *
   832       */
   833      bool IsValid(void)
   834      {
   835          uint8_t length = GetLength();
   836          return ((length >= (sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv))) &&
   837                  (length >= ((sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv)) + (IsThreadEnterprise() ? 0 : sizeof(uint32_t)) +
   838                              sizeof(uint8_t))) &&
   839                  (length >= ((sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv)) + (IsThreadEnterprise() ? 0 : sizeof(uint32_t)) +
   840                              sizeof(uint8_t) + GetServiceDataLength())));
   841      }
   842
   843      /**
   844       * This method gets Service Data length.
   845       *
   846       * @returns length of the Service Data field in bytes.
   847       */
   848      uint8_t GetServiceDataLength(void) { return *GetServiceDataLengthLocation(); }
   849
   850      /**
   851       * This method sets Service Data length.
   852       *
   853       * @param aServiceDataLength desired length of the Service Data field in bytes.
   854       */
   855      void SetServiceDataLength(uint8_t aServiceDataLength) { *GetServiceDataLengthLocation() = aServiceDataLength; }
   856
   857      /**
   858       * This method returns a pointer to the Service Data.
   859       *
   860       * @returns A pointer to the Service Data.
   861       */
   862      uint8_t *GetServiceData(void) { return GetServiceDataLengthLocation() + sizeof(uint8_t); }
   863
   864      /**
   865       * This method sets Service Data to the given values.
   866       *
   867       * Caller must ensure that there is enough memory allocated.
   868       *
   869       * @param aServiceData       pointer to the service data to use
   870       * @param aServiceDataLength length of the provided service data in bytes
   871       */
   872      void SetServiceData(const uint8_t *aServiceData, uint8_t aServiceDataLength)
   873      {
   874          SetServiceDataLength(aServiceDataLength);
   875
   876          memcpy(GetServiceData(), aServiceData, aServiceDataLength);
   877      }
   878
   879      /**
   880       * This method returns Enterprise Number field.
   881       *
   882       * @returns Enterprise Number
   883       */
   884      uint32_t GetEnterpriseNumber(void)
   885      {
   886          if (IsThreadEnterprise())
   887          {
   888              return THREAD_ENTERPRISE_NUMBER;
   889          }
   890          else
   891          {
   892              // This memory access most likely will not be aligned to 4 bytes
   893              return HostSwap32(*reinterpret_cast<uint32_t *>(GetEnterpriseNumberLocation()));
   894          }
   895      }
   896
   897      /**
   898       * This method returns the T flag. It is set when Enterprise Number is equal to THREAD_ENTERPRISE_NUMBER.
   899       *
   900       * @returns Flag whether Enterprise Number is equal to THREAD_ENTERPRISE_NUMBER
   901       */
   902      bool IsThreadEnterprise(void) const { return (mTResSId & kTMask) != 0; }
   903
   904      /**
   905       * This method sets Enterprise Number and updates the T flag.
   906       *
   907       * Note: this method does not preserve service data / sub-TLV fields. Changing the T flag and inserting
   908       * few bytes in the middle of this TLV effectively destroys rest of the content of this TLV (and might lead to
   909       * memory corruption) so modification of Enterprise Number must be done before adding any content to the TLV.

  1091      }

  1095       *
  1096       * @returns The Server Data length in bytes.
  1097       *
  1098       */
  1099      uint8_t GetServerDataLength(void) const { return GetLength() - (sizeof(*this) - sizeof(NetworkDataTlv)); }
  1100
  1101  private:
  1102      uint16_t mServer16;
  1103  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;
